# POP Events

> Local event discovery for Puerto Plata, Sosúa, and Cabarete (North Coast, Dominican Republic). Updated daily in English, Spanish, and French.

Site: https://pop-event.com

## Primary hubs

- [Home (EN)](https://pop-event.com/en): Things to do in Puerto Plata, Sosúa & Cabarete
- [Home (ES)](https://pop-event.com/es): Qué hacer en Puerto Plata, Sosúa y Cabarete
- [Home (FR)](https://pop-event.com/fr): Que faire à Puerto Plata, Sosúa et Cabarete
- [Today](https://pop-event.com/en/when/today): Things to do today on the North Coast
- [This weekend](https://pop-event.com/en/when/weekend): Weekend plans in Puerto Plata, Sosúa & Cabarete
- [Events map](https://pop-event.com/en/map): Map of tonight and this weekend
- [Venues](https://pop-event.com/en/venues): Popular venues directory
